# Mind the Graph

> Mind the Graph is a free infographic maker and scientific illustration platform with 40,000+ customizable templates and illustrations across 80+ scientific fields.

Founded by Fabricio Pamplona and Leonardo Minozzo, Mind the Graph serves researchers, educators, and institutions by providing drag-and-drop tools for creating scientific visualizations, infographics, and presentations. The platform specializes in medical, biological, and STEM-related illustrations for research communication and educational purposes.

## Key Topics

- Scientific illustrations
- Infographic templates
- Scientific visualization
- Drag-and-drop editor
- Research visualization
- Medical illustration
- Customizable templates
- Graphical abstracts
- Scientific communication
- DNA and genetics
- Cardiology
- Neurology
- Educational templates
- STEM education
- Zoology

## Core Platform

- [Mind the Graph - Best Free Infographic Maker for Science](https://mindthegraph.com): Homepage showcasing Mind the Graph's 40,000+ scientific illustrations across 80+ fields with drag-and-drop editor.
- [Scientific Illustrations, Icons, Images & Drawings](https://mindthegraph.com/illustrations): Main gallery of scientific illustrations across Cardiology, Neurology, Surgery, and Urology with customizable options.
- [Free Infographic Templates Made by Scientists](https://mindthegraph.com/infographic-templates): Library of 40,000+ customizable infographic templates for research presentations and scientific communication.

## Enterprise & Services

- [Solutions for Academic Institutions](https://mindthegraph.com/institutions): Enterprise solutions for academic institutions, pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, and medical associations.
- [Custom Services](https://mindthegraph.com/custom-services): Custom design services for biotech, pharmaceutical companies, and educational institutions with professional designers.

## Featured Templates

- [Neutral-18 Template](https://mindthegraph.com/infographic-templates/neutral-18): Customizable neutral design infographic template for scientific communication and research visualization.
- [Neutral-38 Template](https://mindthegraph.com/infographic-templates/neutral-38): Customizable neutral design infographic template with drag-and-drop editor for flexible layouts.
- [Versus10 Template](https://mindthegraph.com/infographic-templates/versus10): Comparative visualization template for DNA biology and side-by-side scientific comparisons.
- [Shell Template](https://mindthegraph.com/infographic-templates/shell-template): Marine biology template for mollusk and zoology visualization in educational contexts.

## Medical & Anatomical Illustrations

- [Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy](https://mindthegraph.com/illustrations/cardiac-resynchronization-therapy): Medical illustration of cardiac resynchronization therapy and biventricular pacemaker for cardiology education.
- [Stroke Human Body Zoom](https://mindthegraph.com/illustrations/stroke-human-body-zoom): Neurological stroke illustration showing cerebrovascular disease in human anatomy for neurology research.
- [Endocrine System Woman Shape](https://mindthegraph.com/illustrations/endocrine-system-woman-shape): Endocrine system illustration showing glands and hormonal system in female anatomy.

## Biology & Life Sciences Illustrations

- [DNA Insertion](https://mindthegraph.com/illustrations/insertion): DNA insertion and chromosomal mutation illustrations for genetics visualization and molecular biology.
- [Lab Equipment - Biochemistry Experiment](https://mindthegraph.com/illustrations/lab-equipments-biochemistry-experiment): Laboratory equipment icons for biochemistry experiments and STEM education visualization.
- [Dolphin Kidney Exterior](https://mindthegraph.com/illustrations/dolphin-kidney-exterior): Anatomical illustration of dolphin kidney exterior for comparative anatomy and zoology projects.
- [Golden Retriever](https://mindthegraph.com/illustrations/golden-retriever): Golden retriever illustration for veterinary anatomy and zoology educational materials.
